intro: Salad and Go is the drive-thru-only chain, strongest in Arizona, Texas and the Southwest, built on big, freshly made salads and wraps at a low price, plus breakfast burritos, soups and hand-crafted lemonades and teas. Its pitch is healthy fast food that costs about the same as a value meal. Below is the full Salad and Go menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: At Salad and Go, a full-size salad or wrap is about $6.79 (some locations $6.24), a breakfast burrito or bowl is $3.99, and drinks like lemonade and iced tea are $1.49. Kids salads are $3.99 and a Kid Protein Box $4.99. The big, cheap made-to-order salads and wraps are the whole idea. Prices vary by location.
hot_deal: Salad and Go value: the whole concept is value, with a big made-to-order salad or wrap around $6.79 and drinks at just $1.49. Breakfast burritos and bowls at $3.99 are among the cheapest healthy breakfasts in fast food. Water is free, and the app drops occasional deals. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is a salad at Salad and Go?
faqs.a: A full-size made-to-order salad or wrap is about $6.79 (some locations around $6.24), which is the chain's whole pitch, a big fresh salad for roughly the price of a value meal. Kids salads are $3.99. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: What is Salad and Go known for?
faqs.a: Salad and Go is a drive-thru-only chain known for big, freshly made salads and wraps at a low price, plus cheap breakfast burritos and $1.49 hand-crafted lemonades and teas. It markets itself as healthy fast food that costs about the same as a value meal.

faqs.q: Does Salad and Go have breakfast?
faqs.a: Yes. Salad and Go serves breakfast burritos and bowls (traditional, bacon-egg-cheese, Southwest and a Fiesta bowl) for about $3.99 each, among the cheapest healthy fast-food breakfasts around.

faqs.q: Does Salad and Go publish calories?
faqs.a: Salad and Go publishes nutrition on its website and app, but item calories are not reproduced here and are left blank rather than guessed. Because salads are build-your-own with your choice of protein and dressing, totals vary a lot.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Salad and Go?
faqs.a: Favorites include the build-your-own salad, the buffalo chicken salad, the breakfast burritos, the hand-crafted lemonades, and the Cobb salad.
